SOURCE_RECEIPT.capture: Single HTTP GET through app.Fetcher with robots.txt check; Dell Top Deals HTML contains ProductsDetailInfo JSON. No pagination, product-page crawl, sign-in or checkout.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.local_evidence: 36 embedded offers parsed; 34 with current and market reference; 2 current-only; 36 normalized rows in a local catalog test.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.variant_policy: productId + variantCode + product URL; configuration and GTIN are not independently verified.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.limitations: One page only; marketPrice is Dell's reference, not a historical paid price; rights review remains open.

PAGING_RECEIPT.strategy: Single Top Deals page; no page parameter followed.

PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.current_price_role: dellPrice from the embedded product object.
PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.regular_price_role: marketPrice only when it is greater than dellPrice; otherwise null.
PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.rejections: Missing title, URL, or dellPrice is skipped; marketPrice at or below dellPrice is not treated as a reference.

IDENTITY_RECEIPT.note: No cross-seller consolidation; base product URL and productId are retained.

RIGHTS_RECEIPT.note: Single local read-only capture; Dell terms, retention and redistribution rights remain unresolved.

CATALOG_RECEIPT.local_test: 36 Dell rows merged into a temporary catalog with source Dell.

TEST_RECEIPT.fixture: Synthetic HTML containing the observed ProductsDetailInfo JSON shape.
TEST_RECEIPT.live_capture: One local public-page capture; not an authorized live acceptance.
